_about: Defaults for the preset voices by folder id. A persona.json inside a voice folder overrides these keys; a new folder with neither gets a card derived from its transcript (name = folder, language = script). delivery: speed very_slow|slow|normal|fast|very_fast, expressiveness low|normal|high, pitch low|normal|high, emotion '' or an emotion tag value, strength none|light|strong.

callagent.name: Ali
callagent.description: Polite, steady telecom call-centre agent. Good for support calls and IVR prompts.

callagentfast.name: Ali (fast)
callagentfast.description: The same agent, reference sped up 1.15x: brisk sales-pitch energy. Higgs copies the reference's pace.

shehzad.name: Shehzad
shehzad.description: Measured, clear, report-style delivery. Also a calm storyteller.

commentator.name: Commentator
commentator.description: Live cricket TV commentary (Hindustani): fast, loud, excited.

hammadsh.name: Hammad (read)
hammadsh.description: The same speaker reading a script in Shahmukhi: steadier, story-like.

hammadgu.name: Hammad (Gurmukhi)
hammadgu.description: The same speaker; the reference transcript is in Gurmukhi script.

asad.name: Asad
asad.description: Pashto voice. Its reference clips are Urdu speech (draft transcripts, not verified); the output language follows your text.

trump.name: Trump
trump.description: Rally-style English speech. A real public figure: internal research only, never present output as real.

shehbaz.name: Shehbaz Sharif
shehbaz.description: A sitting head of government: hidden from the customer console (set hidden: false in a persona.json to change).
